name: BATTLEMAGE
description: Arcane and steel. The battlemage wields magic as a weapon, not a study.
blurb: In the drowned markets of Saltmere, battlemage aspirants trade spells for secrets and carve their names into the tide.

name: NECROMANCER
description: Bone and bargain. The necromancer commands what others fear to wake.
blurb: In the ossuary-veils of Palewatch, the dead do not rest — they serve.

name: PALADIN
description: Oath and iron. The paladin is the unbroken wall between the dark and the dawn.
blurb: From the golden halls of Sunspire, paladins carry the ancient oaths into every shadow, and the light follows.

name: DRUID
description: Root and renewal. The druid speaks the language of the living earth.
blurb: Deep in the canopies of Mossgrave, druids tend the old growth and awaken the deep roots.

name: ROGUE
description: Shadow and silver. The rogue strikes where the light forgets to look.
blurb: From the candle-lit crypts of Duskchapel, rogues move through the silence between heartbeats, taking what the dead no longer need.

name: ASTROLOGIST
description: Star and prophecy. The astrologist reads the sky and bends fate.
blurb: In the observatory-spires of Starfall Reach, astrologists chart the celestial tide and whisper to the constellations.

name: WARRIOR
description: Steel and fire. The warrior forges victory from the anvil of battle.
blurb: Tempered in the forge-fires of Emberhold, warriors carry the ancient craft of war into every fight.
